semiconductor_relevance: High — The company produces critical fluorine-based materials used in semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Do-FluoRIDE New Materials Co., Ltd. is a key supplier of fluorine-based chemicals essential for semiconductor manufacturing. Their product portfolio includes Electronic Grade Hydrofluoric Acid, which is crucial for etching processes, and other materials like Lithium Hexafluorophosphate and Anhydrous Aluminum Fluoride that support various semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Production of 60,000 tons per year of Electronic Grade Hydrofluoric Acid
Manufacturing of 65,000 tons per year of Lithium Hexafluorophosphate
Production of 400,000 tons per year of High Molecular Weight Cryolite
